verdict.rationale: Vercel documents programmatic domain management via its REST API/SDK, CLI (manage DNS records, certificates), and MCP tools that can check domain availability/price and buy domains, alongside automatic SSL provisioning for custom domains — the building blocks needed to programmatically provision and route customer domains for a multi-tenant SaaS. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a dedicated multi-tenant/SaaS domains workflow (e.g., per-tenant domain verification at scale, rate limits, or a case study), so it's inferred from generic API/CLI/domain-SSL docs rather than a purpose-built story. Missing for 10: explicit multi-tenant SaaS domain-provisioning API documentation, evidence of scale/rate limits, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the workflow.
